title: Absolute continuity of the law of the solution to the stochastic Cahn-Hilliard equation driven by fractional noise
summary: The stochastic partial differential equation analyzed in this work is the Cahn-Hilliard equation perturbed by an additive fractional white noise (fractional in time and white in space). We work in spatial dimensions $d \in \{1, 2, 3\}$ with $d < 4H$, where $H \in (\frac{1}{2}, 1)$ is the Hurst parameter of the noise, and apply Malliavin calculus to investigate the existence of a density for the solution $u$.
